Senegal named among four countries that have begun feeding INTERPOL's databases through SIPAO

note: INTERPOL's closing newsletter for the programme. For Senegal it states only the criminal analysis cell at CREDIPOL (February 2025), Senegal's feeding of INTERPOL databases, and Senegal as an example of sustainability; it does not say that Senegalese stations or brigades enter reports or cases in SIPAO, so no record fact. Regional totals (14 countries with remote sites connected, 15 with a national budget line of which 5 funded, 729,000 records by early 2025) are not broken down by country.
